topic: Vietnam vet Jim Langdon meets the son he thought was in Thailand; he'd been in the US since age 4 (DNA match, Pensacola 2024)
title: He Thought His Son Was in Thailand. He'd Been in America All Along #truestory
description:
#truestory #veteran #reunion

"He didn't know I spoke English."

Jim left Thailand in 1972 with his girlfriend pregnant. For 51 years he figured his son was over there somewhere. A DNA test found him, a lot closer than Jim ever guessed.

#mayorofmainst #truestory #dnamatch

Source: WEAR, CBS Austin (Feb 2024)

Retold with AI voice & visuals
